title: The Geometry of Cochains on Sampled Vietoris-Rips Complexes
summary: We study the geometry of simplicial cochains on Vietoris-Rips complexes built from i.i.d. samples of a compact embedded manifold. By integrating differential forms over affine simplices, we define a cochain map from smooth forms to simplicial cochains and equip the latter with kernel-weighted inner products determined by ambient pairwise distances.
